newsitem.title: USA: LADD Furniture to supply Marriott furniture.
newsitem.headline: LADD Furniture to supply Marriott furniture.

text.p: LADD Furniture Inc said Wednesday its American of Martinsville unit had signed an agreement to supply all of Marriott International Inc's "casegoods" (wood) guest room furniture.

LADD said the agreement covers both full-service Marriott lodging facilities and Marriott's limited service division, consisting of Marriott Town Place Suites, Courtyards, Fairfield Inns and Residence Inns.

In total, the Marriott Lodging Group represents more than 1,100 properties with nearly 222,000 rooms. Earlier this year Marriott announced plans to add about 120,000 rooms to its lodging brands through the year 2000, including 14,000 outside the U.S.
